headline: Airbnb bans making guests do dishes and take out the trash
summary: Airbnb updates policy, banning hosts from mandating significant guest chores. New rules apply to reservations booked from November 20th onwards. Aims to reduce hassle for guests at checkout.

headline: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
summary: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, a new AI agent to compete with Meta's Muse. Designed for professionals and small business owners. Available as a research preview on iOS, Android, and web.

headline: Walmart is inviting AI agents to shop for you
summary: Walmart will soon allow customers to connect their AI agents for online shopping. Users can approve purchases and set spending limits. This approach contrasts with Amazon's stance on AI agents.

headline: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in penalties over the Cambridge Analytica scandal
summary: Meta fined $25 billion by a New Mexico judge. Penalty for over 43 million violations of state unfair practices law. Marks the biggest legal hit for Meta this year.

headline: Clayface Review
summary: "Clayface" is a fun body horror romp embracing its B-movie absurdity. The film realizes its nasty potential in its final act. Praised for its slow-burn set-up.

headline: The Internet Reacts to the Cancelation of Mass Effect 5 and the Death of BioWare
summary: Fans are reacting strongly to the rumored cancellation of Mass Effect 5. The news has sparked discussions about the future of BioWare. Social media is abuzz with speculation and concern.

headline: Today’s Top Deals: $100 Nintendo, PS, & Xbox Gift Cards, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, and MTG x Marvel
summary: Score deals on $100 Nintendo, PlayStation, and Xbox gift cards. Discounts available on games like Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Last chance to save on Switch Sports Resort and MTG x Marvel.

headline: Glee Reboot Is Officially a Go at Disney+ and Hulu
summary: A "Glee" reboot has been officially ordered by Disney+ and Hulu. Ryan Murphy is behind the new series. Fans are actively sharing their reactions online.

headline: Burnham defends Jackdaw decision as Badenoch urges PM to overturn ban on new oil and gas licences
summary: The UK government defends the Jackdaw gas field project. Environmental campaigners oppose the field due to climate concerns. Gas production could begin by the end of this month.

headline: Google staff resign in backlash over its AI contracts with military
summary: Several Google DeepMind employees have resigned. Resignations due to concerns over AI use on the battlefield. Backlash stems from Google's AI contracts with the military.

headline: Russia says it is ready to resume talks with Ukraine and US to end war
summary: Russia expresses readiness to restart peace talks. Talks would involve Ukraine and the US to end the war. Announcement follows a meeting between Putin and Steve Witkoff.

headline: Websites taken down worldwide as critical cyber-security update issued
summary: Major websites globally experienced outages due to a critical security update. Vulnerabilities in PHP, a widely used programming language, were discovered. These PHP flaws are described as the most significant ever found by AI.
